nodes.label: TerminalIPythonApp
nodes.desc: traitlets application that loads config and profile, then initializes and starts the terminal shell.

nodes.label: TerminalInteractiveShell
nodes.desc: Terminal front end: prompt_toolkit REPL loop, custom prompts, autosuggestions and GUI input hooks.

nodes.label: prompt_toolkit CLI
nodes.desc: init_prompt_toolkit_cli assembles key bindings and filters; prompt_for_code reads each cell.

nodes.label: InteractiveShell
nodes.desc: The 4,200-line engine: user namespaces, transformers, compiler, exec, tracebacks and every init_* subsystem.

nodes.label: run_cell
nodes.desc: Per-cell entry point: tees output, transforms source, awaits run_cell_async, then fires post_run_cell.

nodes.label: TransformerManager
nodes.desc: Token-based rewriter: strips prompts, rewrites %magics, !shell commands and obj? help syntax into Python.

nodes.label: EscapedCommand
nodes.desc: Finds a leading %foo or !foo escape and rewrites the line into a run_line_magic / run_system call.

nodes.label: MagicsManager
nodes.desc: Registry of line and cell magics; owns the 16 Magics classes, aliases and lazy magics.

nodes.label: EventManager
nodes.desc: pre_run_cell and post_run_cell callback registry that extensions hook into.

nodes.label: HistoryManager
nodes.desc: SQLite-backed session history in the profile dir, flushed by a background saving thread.

nodes.label: DisplayHook
nodes.desc: sys.displayhook implementation that prints the Out[n] prompt and publishes the expression result.

nodes.label: DisplayFormatter
nodes.desc: Mime-type formatter registry: plain text, HTML, Markdown, PNG, JPEG, LaTeX, JSON and more.
